notes:
• Price / offer labels → Edit label layout is now a label designer: tick what prints (card name, set, number, grade, SKU, rarity, condition, store name, market price) and add your own text, put each on line 1–4 and pick its size, choose the price size (or no price), and the code: QR on the left or right, a barcode of the SKU at the bottom, or none. A bigger preview at the top shows the label as it will print (it warns when a barcode is too small to scan, e.g. on 1 × 1 in DYMO 30332)
• Card sorting box labels are back to how they were in 2.9.2
